HOW WE READ SIGNALS

把事实和判断拆开。Facts and judgment stay separate.

01 · SNAPSHOT

数据事实Observed metrics

Star、Fork、Release、Commit 与 Issue 来自公开接口，并保存采集时间。没有历史就不显示伪造的增长率。

Stars, forks, releases, commits and issues come from public interfaces with capture times. We do not invent growth rates without history.

02 · REVIEW

编辑判断Editorial judgment

用途、成熟度、安全、成本分别评分。总分不是客观真理，每个分数都应能追溯到理由。

Utility, maturity, safety and cost are scored separately. The total is an editorial judgment, and each score needs a traceable reason.

03 · CHANGE

变化解释Meaningful changes

数据每日记录；只有版本、异常增长、安全事件或方向变化时，才重写结论和评分。

We record metrics daily and revise conclusions when releases, unusual growth, security events or project direction change.

当前限制：新增项目暂基于官方仓库、文档与公开指标评审，尚未完成统一环境安装实测。页面会明确区分“已验证”“官方声明”和“编辑推断”，评分置信度也会随证据更新。Current limit: New projects are initially reviewed from official repositories, documentation and public metrics. We have not installed every project in one controlled environment. Pages distinguish verified findings, vendor claims and editorial inference; confidence changes as evidence improves.
